items.question: What tuition fee in AED must expatriate students pay to attend government schools in the UAE?
items.gold: Expatriate students pay 6,000 AED as tuition fees to attend public schools.
items.fact: Expatriate public school tuition fee is 6,000 AED

items.question: What maximum percentage of total capacity in each public school and classroom may expatriate students occupy in the UAE?
items.gold: Expatriate students should not exceed 20 per cent of the total capacity in each public school and each classroom.
items.fact: Expatriates capped at 20% of school capacity
